name: Tonari no Oyako wa Nikushokukei!? ~Ai to Yokubou to Yuuwaku no Hibi wa Hikkoshi to Tomo ni Otozureru~
original_name: 隣の母娘は肉食系!? ～愛と欲望と誘惑の日々は引越しと共に訪れる～
source:
For a long time, the room next to me in the apartment was unoccupied.

However, one day, when I saw the signs of moving and looked next door, there were a beautiful mother and daughter.

Mother: "We just moved here. Nice to meet you."

Daughter: "...Hi"

A sociable mother and a slightly unfriendly daughter.

While I bashfully returned their greetings, I was strangely excited.

After that, we kept on meeting and our relationship deepened.

In proportion to that, both mother and daughter became more aggressive.

What are waiting for me in the future...?

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=939779]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
很长一段时间，公寓里我隔壁的房间没人住。

然而有一天，当我看到搬家的迹象，往隔壁一看，竟然有一对漂亮的母女。

妈妈：“我们刚搬到这里。很高兴认识你。”

女儿：“……嗨”

一个善于交际的母亲和一个有点不友善的女儿。

当我羞涩地回应他们的问候时，我却感到异常兴奋。

此后，我们不断见面，我们的关系也更加深入。

与此相对应，母女俩都变得更具攻击性。

未来有什么在等待着我……？

[译自[url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=939779]Getchu[/url]]
